about_the_game:
Step into the captivating world of IN LOVE: Romance Edition, a special pack bringing together three original love stories where every choice matters. In Interview with Fate, one unexpected encounter could change everything. With Tessa’s Choice, follow a heroine torn between passion and reason. Finally, The Rhythm of Passion invites you into a romance fueled by music, emotions, and unforgettable connections.

IN LOVE stands out with its immersive storytelling, richly drawn characters, and beautiful artwork. Every dialogue and decision leads you closer to a unique ending, making each playthrough a new adventure. Unlock exclusive illustrations as milestones of your romantic journey and dive deeper into stories that evolve with you.

Available in more than 20 languages and updated weekly with fresh content, IN LOVE is the ultimate destination for fans of interactive romance stories. Let yourself be swept away and write your own unforgettable love story.
